# Requirements for running the testgen tools.
-r ../requirements.txt
# The generator's formatting post-pass runs autopep8 and isort, and they are pinned in
# dev_requirements.txt rather than here: they have to be the same versions the
# pre-commit hooks run, or the hooks rewrite generated files and `--check` reports a
# difference the generator cannot remove.

# The CLI is click and the config and report commands render through rich.  Neither
# ships: nothing under tools/ is packaged by setup.py, so these stay out of
# requirements.txt and out of the wheel's install_requires.
click~=8.1
rich~=14.0
